title: Things to Do in Chikmagalur: Coffee, Karnataka's Highest Peak & Hoysala Temples
seoTitle: Things to Do in Chikmagalur: Peaks, Coffee & Falls | Kudozz Club
description: Things to do in Chikmagalur: sunrise at Mullayanagiri, Baba Budangiri, Kemmangundi and Z Point, Hebbe and Jhari falls, coffee estate stays, the Kudremukh trek, Bhadra safaris, Hirekolale lake, and the Hoysala temples of Belur and Halebidu.
dek: The birthplace of coffee in India, with Karnataka's highest peak, shola grasslands, waterfalls and some of the country's finest carved temples nearby.
searchIntent: Weekenders from Bengaluru and trekkers planning two or three days in Chikmagalur for peaks, coffee and waterfalls.
intro: Chikmagalur (Chikkamagaluru) lies in the Baba Budan hills of the Western Ghats, about five hours from Bengaluru. According to legend, coffee first came to India here in the 17th century, when the Sufi saint Baba Budan brought seven beans from Yemen and planted them in the hills. Today the district is covered in coffee estates shaded by tall trees.

The things to do in Chikmagalur combine the outdoors and heritage: sunrise at Mullayanagiri, Karnataka's highest peak; the shrine at Baba Budangiri; waterfalls such as Hebbe and Jhari; treks in Kudremukh; safaris in Bhadra; and the Hoysala temples of Belur and Halebidu, recognised by UNESCO in 2023.
Two to three days is ideal. October to March is best for views and treks; the monsoon brings dramatic waterfalls but slippery trails.
quickAnswer: Visit the shrine at Baba Budangiri
Take a jeep to Hebbe Falls
Go on a safari in Bhadra Tiger Reserve
See the Hoysala temples at Belur and Halebidu

items.name: Watch sunrise from Mullayanagiri
body: Mullayanagiri, at about 1,930 metres, is the highest peak in Karnataka. A road climbs most of the way, and steps lead to a small temple at the top. At sunrise, clouds often fill the valleys below. Weekends are crowded and vehicle entry may be regulated; go early on a weekday if you can.

facts.Good to know: Crowd and vehicle limits at weekends

items.name: Visit Baba Budangiri
body: Baba Budangiri, a range next to Mullayanagiri, has a cave shrine revered by both Hindus, as Sri Guru Dattatreya Peetha, and Muslims, as the shrine of Baba Budan. The grasslands around it are beautiful, and Manikyadhara Falls is nearby.

items.name: See Kemmangundi and Z Point
body: Kemmangundi, a small hill station developed by the Mysore kings, has gardens and a short trek to Z Point, a ridge with views across the Shola forests and valleys. Shanti Falls is on the way.

items.name: Take a jeep to Hebbe Falls

image.alt: Hebbe Falls in the forest near Kemmangundi
image.caption: Hebbe Falls

body: Hebbe Falls, near Kemmangundi, drops about 168 metres in two stages inside a forest. Jeeps run through coffee estates and forest to near the falls, followed by a short walk. Access depends on forest department rules and may close in heavy rain.

facts.Good to know: Access can close in heavy rain

items.name: Visit Jhari Falls
body: Jhari Falls, also called Buttermilk Falls for its white water, is reached by jeep through coffee estates and a short walk. It has a small pool at the base.

items.name: See Kalhatti Falls
body: Kalhatti Falls, near Kemmangundi, flows beside an old Veerabhadra temple and is popular with pilgrims and visitors after the monsoon.

items.name: Stay on a coffee estate
body: Chikmagalur has many estate homestays and resorts where you can walk through the plantations, see how coffee is picked and processed, and drink estate-grown coffee. The Coffee Board's museum in town explains the crop's history. Harvest is from about November to February.

items.name: Trek in Kudremukh
body: Kudremukh National Park, about 95 km away, protects rolling shola grasslands and forest. The trek to Kudremukh peak, whose profile is said to resemble a horse's face, is one of Karnataka's best, around 20 km return. It requires a forest department permit and a guide, and numbers are limited.

items.name: Go on a safari in Bhadra
body: Bhadra Tiger Reserve, south of the Baba Budan hills, has tigers, elephants, gaur and many birds. Jeep safaris run from Lakkavalli and Muthodi, and boat safaris on the Bhadra reservoir are possible.

items.name: Watch sunset at Hirekolale Lake
body: Hirekolale Lake, a few kilometres from town, reflects the Mullayanagiri range and is a quiet spot for sunset.

items.name: See Belur and Halebidu

image.alt: Carved walls of the Hoysaleswara Temple, Halebidu
image.caption: Hoysaleswara Temple, Halebidu

body: The Chennakeshava Temple at Belur (12th century) and the Hoysaleswara Temple at Halebidu are masterpieces of Hoysala architecture, covered with intricate soapstone carvings of deities, dancers, animals and epics. Along with Somanathapura, they were inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2023. Belur is about 25 km and Halebidu about 30 km from Chikmagalur.

facts.Good to know: Hire a guide to read the carvings

items.name: Visit Sringeri and Horanadu
body: Sringeri, on the Tunga river, is home to the Sharada Peetham founded by Adi Shankaracharya and the Vidyashankara Temple with its zodiac pillars. Horanadu's Annapoorneshwari Temple, in the hills, serves free meals to all visitors.

byTraveller.text: Mullayanagiri at sunrise, Baba Budangiri, a coffee estate stay and Belur on the way back.
Kudremukh with a permit, Z Point and the Baba Budan grasslands.
Belur, Halebidu and Sringeri for temple art and philosophy.

oneDay: Drive to Mullayanagiri for sunrise and then to Baba Budangiri. After lunch, take a jeep to Jhari Falls and end the day at Hirekolale Lake for sunset.
tips: Kadur and Chikmagalur have railway stations; Bengaluru and Mangaluru are the nearest major airports.
Roads to the peaks are narrow and winding; drive carefully, especially in mist.
Leeches are common in the monsoon; wear leech socks.
Weekend crowds at Mullayanagiri can be heavy; start early.

faqs.q: What are the best things to do in Chikmagalur?
faqs.a: Watch sunrise at Mullayanagiri, visit Baba Budangiri, Kemmangundi and Z Point, see Hebbe and Jhari falls, stay on a coffee estate, trek Kudremukh, go on a Bhadra safari and visit Belur and Halebidu.

faqs.q: How many days are enough for Chikmagalur?
What is the best time to visit Chikmagalur?
faqs.a: October to March for clear views and treks; the monsoon for waterfalls.

faqs.q: Is Chikmagalur good for a weekend trip from Bangalore?
faqs.a: Yes. It is about five hours by road and makes a relaxed two- or three-day break.
